battle.name: 徐世勣討王德仁之戰
battle.brief: 武德元年（618）十一月，江南梁王蕭梁遣大將王德仁沿淮泗汴水北上，掠取陳留、豫兗一帶，威脅黎陽倉；唐命東海郡公徐世勣自黎陽出擊，在汴水線上擊破梁軍，王德仁兵敗被擒。卡面羅馬重步兵屬公元前二世紀裝備，未用於此役，其「靠兵源與補給線」的特質對應徐世勣以黎陽倉為出擊支點的戰法。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 武德元年（618）十一月的河南，交戰的兩方都已經不再使用隋朝的旗號。唐一方是關中新建的唐朝在東翼的部署：受高祖李淵委任、以黎陽倉為基地的東海郡公徐世勣所部，這支部隊的主體是原瓦崗軍的步騎與歸附的河南郡縣兵，另有黎陽倉的守軍、屯田丁夫與沿汴水、黃河轉運糧秣的船戶，後方是長安朝廷的詔令與關中出關的援應。梁一方是江南的梁王蕭梁派到江北的部隊，主將王德仁，所部多為淮南、淮北與泗水一線的梁軍，並裹挾沿途的團練與水師船隻，後方是建康一帶的糧餉、舟師與兵器作坊。戰區裡還站著第三方：王世充控制洛陽，竇建德控制河北並新取冀州，沈法興與杜伏威分據吳郡與江淮。蕭梁與竇建德在這一年互相確認名號，試圖以南北兩翼夾擊唐的東面；唐必須在洛陽與黎陽之間把線守住，因此才有徐世勣這次主動出擊。梁方的指揮系統由蕭梁在江東的中樞分派州郡與兵員，前線由大將與各路將領分統，後方靠淮水、汴水的水運與江南的徵發供應；唐方則是靠關中的兵源與黎陽的存糧維持一支剛剛歸附的部隊。
countriesEn: The fighting in Henan in the eleventh month of Wude 1 (618) was between two sides that had already stopped using the Sui banner. The Tang side was the eastern deployment of the new Tang court in Guanzhong: the troops of the Duke of Donghai, Xu Shiji, whom Emperor Gaozu had commissioned to hold the Liyang granary where the old Yellow River course meets the Bian. The core of that force was the infantry and cavalry of the old Wagang army together with the county militia that had submitted in Henan; with them came the garrison of the granary, the farmhands and corvee drivers, and the boat crews who moved grain along the Bian and the Yellow River. Its rear was the decrees of the Chang'an court and the reinforcements that could be marched out of Guanzhong. The Liang side was a column sent north from Jiangnan by the King of Liang, Xiao Liang, commanded by Wang Deren: mostly Liang troops from the Huai and Si districts, with levies pressed in from the countryside and river craft pressed into service, backed by grain, shipyards and arsenals in Jiankang. Third parties stood around the theatre: Wang Shichong at Luoyang, Dou Jiande in Hebei after his capture of Jizhou, Shen Faxing at Wujun and Du Fuwei along the Jiang-Huai. In this same year Xiao Liang and Dou Jiande confirmed one another's titles, trying to link a northern and a southern front against the Tang. The Tang had to hold the line between Luoyang and Liyang, and that is why Xu Shiji went out to attack instead of waiting behind his walls. On the Liang side the command system ran from the central government at Jiangnan, which allotted commanderies and men to the front, where generals and subordinate commanders held separate columns; their rear was supplied by water transport on the Huai and the Bian and by the levies of Jiangnan. On the Tang side a newly submitted army was kept in the field by the manpower of Guanzhong and by the grain stored at Liyang.
people: 徐世勣（即李世勣，隋末起兵，與李密結為生死之交，瓦崗敗後以黎陽降唐，授東海郡公，位至唐太宗朝宰相，卒於貞觀末年）是本役的唐方主帥。他不是在城頭死守，而是以黎陽為出發點主動討敵：先整頓降眾、登記倉儲，再探明梁軍的進攻方向，最後擇地出擊。降唐之後的瓦崗舊部尚未編入唐軍正式序列，他本人也仍在證明自己，黎陽這場戰事正是他交出的第一份答卷。梁方主將王德仁，事蹟傳世極少，只在唐初數種史書中留下數語：他是蕭梁在江北的將領，與同為梁將的樂茂等人並稱。關於王德仁究竟隸屬蕭梁還是竇建德，諸說並存；但可以確定的是，他率領的是一支由江淮北上、意圖伸入豫兗的兵馬，而此戰之後他本人仍見於史乘，卒於唐武德四年（621）六月。樂茂是傳記中與王德仁同列的另一名梁將，部分史文記他與王德仁同在陳留一線，敗後退走淮南，此外事跡不明。蕭梁本人、魏王竇建德、鄭王王世充、吳王杜伏威均在背景之中，樂茂與王德仁的勝負，最後都算在蕭梁與唐的帳上。
peopleEn: Xu Shiji, better known as Li Shiji, rose in arms at the end of the Sui and was bound to Li Mi by an oath of life and death. When the Wagang cause collapsed he came over to the Tang with the granary of Liyang, was made Duke of Donghai, and would go on to serve as chancellor under Emperor Taizong, dying in the closing years of the Zhenguan era. He is the Tang commander in this campaign, and he is not a man who waited behind a wall. Liyang was his springboard: first he reorganised the men who had just submitted and took stock of the grain in store, then he found out which way Wang Deren's column was moving, and only then did he choose his ground and strike. The Wagang veterans were not yet incorporated into the regular Tang army, and Xu himself was still proving what he was worth; the fighting at Liyang was the answer he gave. Wang Deren, the Liang commander, is very nearly unknown: he survives in a handful of sentences in the histories written at the beginning of the Tang. He was a general of Xiao Liang in the lands north of the Yangtze, named in the sources alongside another Liang officer, Yue Mao. Whether he served Xiao Liang or Dou Jiande is a matter of competing statements; what is certain is that he led a force moving north out of the Jiang-Huai with the intention of pushing into Yuzhou and Yanzhou, and that he was still alive after this battle, dying in the sixth month of Wude 4 (621). Yue Mao is the other Liang general remembered in the same breath as Wang Deren; some texts put him with Wang in the Chenliu area, and after the defeat he fell back towards the Huai. Xiao Liang himself, Dou Jiande, Wang Shichong and Du Fuwei all stood in the background, and the measure of Yue Mao and Wang Deren was finally entered in the accounts of Liang and Tang.
kits: 卡面是公元前二世紀的羅馬重步兵，身披分段鎏甲，肩甲、胸甲、裙甲各自分段，靠一具弧形重盾護住正面，配短劍與投槍，靠補充兵源與補給線維持戰力。這套裝備並未出現在中國戰場，與本役相隔七百餘年；它在這張卡上要說明的是「重裝步兵的戰力從何而來」：羅馬重步兵的力氣不來自甲胄本身，而來自兵源、糧道與國家機器對前線的持續供給。本役現場的裝備是隋唐一系的樣子。唐方步卒戴漆皮兜鍪，披明光甲、札甲或魚鱗皮甲，長槊與大盾結陣，弩手用擘張弩與駕機弩在陣後覆蓋射擊，騎兵著馬鎧、執馬槊作衝鋒之用；攻城與守城則有雲梯、撞車、砲車、火箭與投石機，糧秣靠黎陽倉的儲糧、汴水與黃河的水運，以及驢馬騾牛的陸路輓運。梁方是江南水軍傳統：重甲少而弓弩多，鬥艦、艓艋與走舸成軍，兼用火船與火炬，適合在淮泗與汴水的縱橫水網裡機動。若要找功能上的對應，羅馬重步兵面對的正是本役的關鍵題目：重裝步兵一旦離開補給線就會失去戰力。徐世勣之所以能討平王德仁，靠的正是把黎陽倉變成進擊的支點；反過來，梁軍靠水網往來與小股襲擾拖延，正是不肯把主力與後勤押在一處。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman legionary of the second century BC, wearing segmented plate armour with shoulder, breast and skirt plates articulated separately, protected on the front by a curved heavy shield, and carrying a short sword and a javelin; the Romans kept such men in the field by replenishing the manpower and keeping the supply line open, not by the weight of their armour. None of this was ever seen on a Chinese battlefield, and it stands more than seven hundred years away from this campaign; what the card is here to explain is where the power of armoured infantry comes from: not from the armour itself, but from the men, the grain road and the state machinery that keep feeding it. What was actually on the ground is of the Sui-Tang pattern. Tang foot soldiers wore lacquered leather or iron helmets and coats of lamellar or brigandine plate, stood in ranks of long spear and large shield, and were covered from behind by crossbowmen using the powerful draw-crossbow and the mounted trigger-lock crossbow. The cavalry went in armoured caparisons with long cavalry lances. Siege and defence used scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers, rockets and catapults. Grain came out of the stores at Liyang, was moved by water on the Bian and the Yellow River, and was carried overland by donkeys, horses and mules. The Liang army carried the southern tradition: little heavy armour, many bows and crossbows, war-junks and light fast boats, and fire-ships and torches for work in a landscape of water. If a functional correspondence is wanted, the Roman legionary faces exactly the question at issue here: armoured infantry lose their fighting value the moment they leave their supply line. Xu Shiji was able to punish Wang Deren precisely because he turned the Liyang granary into the hinge of his offensive; the Liang method, by contrast, was to move along the waterways and raid with small detachments rather than commit troops and supply to a single place.
tactics: 本役的具體部署在史籍中幾乎全缺，只有《資治通鑑》等書一句概括，因此陣形、次序與時刻都無從考訂，只能從隋唐以來的兵制與地理推測其大概。可以確定的框架是這樣的：徐世勣以黎陽為基地，把從瓦崗承繼下來的數萬眾與河南歸附的郡縣兵編為中軍，另以輕騎巡行汴水兩岸，封鎖水口、偵察敵情、遮斷梁軍的糧道與援軍；等王德仁的兵馬離開淮泗水網深入豫地，再集中出擊，選擇靠近水際的地段展開，以免潰兵四散而無從追殲。正面以長槊結陣、大盾遮蔽，用來頂住梁軍的衝鋒；兩翼以騎兵掩護包抄，待梁軍隊形一亂即合擊；追擊多在水際淺灘進行，同時奪取或擊毀梁軍的舟船，使對方失去水網中的退路。梁軍的打法則相反：盡量不與唐軍主力在開闊地正面相撞，以舟船與騎兵沿汴水快速進逼，掠取郡縣、擄取糧秣，用散騎擾亂唐軍的徵發與運轉，等唐軍主力離開倉城再突然出現於其側後。這一類襲擾式的打法對糧秣與徵發的破壞最大，也最難被徹底消滅；史載此役梁軍一敗而散，說明唐軍把黎陽至陳留這條線上的水陸控制權先奪了回來。
tacticsEn: The actual deployment of this battle survives almost nowhere: the histories carry only a general formula of the kind that Xu Shiji marched against Wang Deren, so formations, order of attack and hours cannot be checked. What can be reconstructed is the frame from the military system of the Sui and Tang and from the geography of the ground. The frame runs as follows. Xu Shiji used Liyang as his base, organised the tens of thousands inherited from the Wagang together with the county troops of Henan who had submitted into a central body, and sent light horse to patrol both banks of the Bian, closing the water mouths, scouting the enemy and cutting Wang Deren's supply line and reinforcements. He waited until the Liang troops had left the Huai-Si water network and pushed deep into Yuzhou, then struck, choosing ground near the water so that a routed enemy could not scatter untraced. On the front he formed spear ranks behind large shields to hold the Liang charge; on the flanks cavalry worked round and closed in once the enemy formation gave way. The pursuit was fought in the shallows along the water, where the Liang boats were taken or broken up so that the defeated could not escape back into the network of channels. The Liang method was the mirror image: they avoided meeting the Tang main body in the open, used boats and horse to come on fast along the Bian, stripped the commanderies of grain and stores, and sent scattered riders to harass Tang recruitment and transport, waiting for the Tang army to leave its granary city before appearing on its flank. Raiding of this kind does the most harm to supplies and conscription and is the hardest to wipe out. The record that the Liang force broke up after one defeat shows that the Tang first took back the control of the water and road line between Liyang and Chenliu.
data: 關於數字，這場戰爭留下的記載極少，兵員的多寡、斬獲的數目與往返的日程都沒有確數，因此只能列出有根據的部分。時間線大致如此：隋大業十四年（618）正月末，隋亡於江都，瓦崗軍在邙山敗於王世充，李密西入關中降唐，瓦崗舊眾隨之四散；同年秋末冬初，蕭梁遣王德仁出師北伐，徐世勣率黎陽之眾迎擊，戰事落在陳留、汴水下游一線；十一月，竇建德在河北取冀州、進封冀王，竇建德與蕭梁互封名號也在這一段時間裡完成。王德仁本人卒於武德四年（621）六月，距此役約一年半。地理上，黎陽倉在滑州，據黃河故道與汴水交會之處；自黎陽至陳留水陸兼程約二百餘里，是梁軍由淮南北上最自然的推進線，也是唐軍必須守住的一段。糧食方面，黎陽倉是隋代留在河南的最大儲糧之一，諸史所載數目不一，但量級以百萬石計，這也是瓦崗與唐能夠據城固守、屢敗強敵的根本緣由。戰役本身的兵數與斬獲，兩造史書都未記載，本篇不作估算。
dataEn: On numbers, this battle leaves very little behind: there is no firm count of the men on either side, of the prisoners taken, or of the days spent on the march, so only what can be supported will be set down. The time sequence runs roughly as follows. In the last month of Dayuan 14 (618) the Sui fell at Jiangdu; the Wagang army was beaten at Mangshan by Wang Shichong; Li Mi went west into Guanzhong and surrendered to the Tang, and the old Wagang men scattered to all sides. In the late autumn or early winter of the same year Xiao Liang dispatched Wang Deren on his northern expedition, Xu Shiji came out from Liyang to meet him, and the fighting fell along the Bian below Chenliu. In the eleventh month Dou Jiande took Jizhou in Hebei and was advanced to the title of Prince of Ji, and the exchange of titles between him and Xiao Liang was completed in the same stretch of time. Wang Deren himself died in the sixth month of Wude 4 (621), about a year and a half after this battle. In geography, the Liyang granary stood in Youzhou, at the meeting of the old Yellow River course and the Bian waterway; from Liyang to Chenliu, by water and by road together, is a little over two hundred li, which made it the most natural line of advance for a force coming north out of the Huai and Si, and also the stretch the Tang had to hold. On stores, Liyang was one of the largest grain depots the Sui left behind in Henan. The figures in the histories differ, but the order of magnitude is one million shi, and that is the material reason why the Wagang and then the Tang could hold a city and wear out stronger enemies time and again. The strength of the armies in this battle and the numbers of the defeated are not recorded by either side, and no estimate is offered here.
cause: 打起來的根由有兩層。遠因是隋朝崩潰。大業年間三征高句麗、徭役與兵禍並行，隋末的起事者已在河南、江淮、河北各自占據州郡；大業十四年（618）正月宇文化及在江都殺隋煬帝，東都楊侗另立傀儡，王世充以洛陽為中心收羅舊部，竇建德在河北建起自己的政權，江南則有蕭梁與沈法興各據一方。李密的瓦崗軍本是中原最大的軍勢，兵眾與糧倉都在河南，然而在邙山一敗之後，瓦崗散歸各處，唐的東翼一時空虛。近因是蕭梁的北上。蕭梁不甘於只守江東，趁唐軍主力集中在關中、瓦崗餘眾未散的空檔，遣大將王德仁沿淮泗、汴水北上，掠取豫州、兗州、陳留一帶，直接威脅黎陽與洛陽之間的通道；與此同時，蕭梁與竇建德相互確認名號，把河北與江東連成一條南北呼應的線。對唐而言，黎陽是關中東面的屏障與儲糧所在，丟了它，關中便直接暴露在東來的兵鋒之下；因此高祖李淵命徐世勣以東海郡公之任出擊，必須把王德仁的北路打斷，把陳留一線收回。
causeEn: There are two layers to the causes. The deeper one is the collapse of the Sui. The campaigns against Goguryeo in the Dayuan years, the corvee levies and the ruin of the war came on top of one another, and by the end of the Sui the rebel lords had taken commanderies in Henan, the Jiang-Huai and Hebei alike. In the first month of Dayuan 14 (618) Yuwen Huaji had the Emperor Yang killed at Jiangdu, the Eastern Capital set up a puppet under Yang Tong, Wang Shichong gathered the old troops around Luoyang, Dou Jiande built a state of his own in Hebei, and in Jiangnan Xiao Liang and Shen Faxing each held one half of the country. The Wagang army of Li Mi had been the largest military force in the plains, with its men and its granaries in Henan, but after the defeat at Mangshan it fell apart, and the eastern wing of the Tang was for a moment empty. The nearer cause is the northern thrust of Xiao Liang. Unwilling to stay behind in Jiangnan, and taking advantage of the interval while the Tang army was concentrated in Guanzhong and the Wagang remnants were still drifting apart, he sent the general Wang Deren north along the Huai, the Si and the Bian to strip Yuzhou, Yanzhou and Chenliu, threatening the corridor between Liyang and Luoyang. At the same time Xiao Liang and Dou Jiande confirmed each other's titles, linking Hebei and Jiangnan into a single north-south line of mutual support. For the Tang, Liyang was the screen on the eastern side of Guanzhong and the place where the grain was stored; to lose it would have exposed Guanzhong directly to troops coming from the east. Gaozu Li Yuan therefore gave Xu Shiji, as Duke of Donghai, the task of going out, of breaking Wang Deren's northern advance and of taking back the line of Chenliu.
impact: 此役的直接後果，是陳留與汴水下游一線回到唐軍控制之下，黎陽至陳留的糧道與水路從此不再受江淮方面的威脅；梁軍在河南的北進被打斷，蕭梁退回江淮，士氣與兵力都受了重創，其在北方再也沒有成建制的動作。更遠的影響有幾層。第一，唐朝在河南東翼站穩了腳跟，使它能把力量集中到河北。蕭梁與竇建德互封名號所形成的南北呼應被切斷，李世民次年得以率主力東出，在虎牢關一戰全勝竇建德，魏國夏政權覆亡；其中徐世勣所部的河南兵與黎陽的糧秣，正是東征可以倚靠的基地與後勤。第二，隋末的府兵與倉儲制度在這一場戰事裡被新王朝實戰檢驗了一次：以巨量存糧的倉城為出擊支點、以徵發與水運維持一支剛歸附的部隊，勝過在水網中靠襲擾維生的打法，這一取向日後在唐對高句麗、對西域的戰役中又見重用。第三，王德仁這類敵方將領在史書中只留下寥寥數語的現象本身值得注意：初唐史家立傳重唐室功臣，對敗於唐手的對手往往只記其最後一次出現在哪一年；王德仁卒於武德四年六月，便說明他在 618 年之後仍是梁方的重要人物，而非陣歿於此役。
impactEn: The immediate result was that Chenliu and the lower Bian came back under Tang control, and the grain road and waterway between Liyang and Chenliu was no longer open to threat from the south. The Liang northern drive was broken, Xiao Liang fell back into the Jiang-Huai, and both his spirits and his manpower were badly hit; he made no more formed-up moves in the north. The longer effects run in several layers. First, the Tang gained a firm footing on the eastern wing of Henan and could concentrate on Hebei. The north-south understanding between Xiao Liang and Dou Jiande was cut, and in the following year Li Shimin led his main army east, destroyed Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, and ended the state of Wei and Xia; the Henan troops under Xu Shiji and the grain of Liyang were exactly the base and the logistics that expedition leaned on. Second, the fubing and granary system inherited from the Sui was tested in combat for the first time by the new dynasty: using a storehouse city of enormous grain as the hinge of an offensive, and maintaining a newly submitted army by conscription and water transport, proved better than living off raiding in a water network, and that approach was used again in Tang wars against Goguryeo and in the West. Third, the very thin record of an enemy general such as Wang Deren is itself instructive: the historians who founded the Tang's biographies weighted the credit of the Tang's own generals and often noted the enemy only by the year of his last appearance. The fact that Wang Deren died in the sixth month of Wude 4 shows that he remained an important man of the Liang after 618, and that he did not fall in this battle.
result: 結局是唐軍勝。梁軍北進之師在陳留、汴水一線被徐世勣擊破，王德仁兵敗被擒（一說戰歿），樂茂等各潰退淮南，陳留一帶的郡縣重歸唐軍控制，黎陽至陳留的通道重新打通；蕭梁的勢力退回江淮，江北的進取計畫就此破滅。就全局而言，這是一場規模不大卻位置吃緊的戰役。它沒有消滅一支主力，卻把隋末最有可能連成一片的江東與河北兩股力量在河南中段切開，使唐得以先守住東翼，再回頭收拾河北；蕭梁此後只剩江東與兩淮的殘局，終於在武德四年蕭梁病歿於江東、其眾分別降唐或併入杜伏威與沈法興的勢力，江淮的割據局面才被逐一收拾乾淨。也要老老實實記下這場戰役的史料空白：出兵的日數、交戰的地名、兩造的兵數與斬獲，兩造史書都沒有留下可用的記載；我們只知道唐方主帥、敵方主將與大致方向、月份，其餘多靠制度與地理推補。「徐世勣討王德仁」這七個字之所以能立成一場戰役的標題，靠的正是徐世勣在隋末唐初的關鍵位置——他守住了黎陽的糧，也守住了唐在河南的門戶。
resultEn: The outcome was a Tang victory. The Liang column moving north was broken by Xu Shiji along the Bian at Chenliu; Wang Deren was taken in his defeat (in one account he fell in the fighting), Yue Mao and the others broke up towards the Huai, the commanderies of the Chenliu area returned to Tang control, and the corridor from Liyang to Chenliu was opened again. The plans of Xiao Liang in the north were broken, and his power retreated into the Jiang-Huai. In the wider view this was a small battle fought in a sensitive place. It destroyed no main army, yet it cut in the middle of Henan the two strongest forces of the late Sui, the one in Jiangnan and the one in Hebei, that might otherwise have joined up, and so the Tang could hold its eastern wing first and then deal with Hebei. Xiao Liang was left with nothing but the debris of Jiangnan and the two Huai regions; when he died of illness in Jiangnan in Wude 4 (621), and his followers went over to the Tang or were absorbed by the camps of Du Fuwei and Shen Faxing, the fragmented Jiang-Huai was picked up one piece at a time. The blank spaces in the record must also be stated plainly: the number of days on campaign, the place of the engagement, the strength of each side and the numbers of the defeated were left by neither side in any usable form. We know the Tang commander, the enemy commander, the general direction and the month; the rest is filled in from institutions and geography. The seven characters naming Xu Shiji's campaign against Wang Deren can stand as the title of a battle only because of the position Xu Shiji held in the late Sui and early Tang: he held the grain of Liyang, and with it the doorway into Henan.
